bio.text: Hilary Holley represents District 51, part of Polk County, in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Holley was elected on March 24, 2026.
Holley lives in Polk City and is a nonprofit executive director.
Holley holds degrees from Santa Fe College (AA) and the University of Florida (BS), and was born in Punta Gorda, Florida.
